commit_message: Add ADR 0126 Audio and VFX Timeline authoring
pr_title: Implement ADR 0126 Timeline and Sequencer runtime
pr_body:
## ADR 0126 implementation

Current-main implementation of ADR 0126. This request adds typed ADR 0122 Audio and ADR 0125 VFX Timeline tracks through the shared Timeline authoring/validation/compiler boundary, adds canonical save to the GUI-free authoring service, and gives Events explicit source Timeline identity. Audio remains explicitly NonSeekable because the formal tracked-voice API exposes no seek offset; VFX is ReplayRequired and uses the bounded forward reconstruction contract.

The PR remains Draft until runtime composition, Timeline Player / Project Rust control, shared Editor/CLI/MCP authoring parity, Sequencer, persistent Scene View preview, packaged Player, Windows Validation, and Visual Validation are complete.
